final: WITH g AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg1 FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.account_id, g.cnt, a1.avg1 FROM g JOIN a1 ON a1.avg1 IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a1.avg1), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg2 FROM k), r AS (SELECT k.account_id, k.cnt, k.cnt - k.avg1 AS d1 FROM k) SELECT r.account_id, r.cnt, r.d1, r.cnt - a2.avg2 AS d2 FROM r JOIN a2 ON a2.avg2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r.cnt - a2.avg2) IS NULL, (r.cnt - a2.avg2) DESC LIMIT 10
